effects.label: Burn
effects.description: Damages the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the debuff. Creates a Damage Zone around the recipient, damaging any of their allies in the indicated radius by a percentage of their MAX HP every tick.The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This debuff can be stacked.

bio: Honoshi's arrival was a promise – a promise that better times were to come. Whereas its brother Titan, Hamaga, bristles with the madness and fury of their Demon forebears, Honoshi gleams with the Cambion's hopes and dreams of when they were freed from Malice. Birthed by the chance of their own future, and guided by a destiny that they can chart themselves.
